script.title: Captain Science and the Temple of Klameth
script.description: Captain Science travels back to 10,000 B.C. to stop the evil Doctor Khartoum from unleashing a forgotten power.

shots.narration: Captain Science faces death by sacrifice!
The villain Doctor Khartoum threatens our modern world.
He seeks a power more evil than death.
Captain Science tracks the monster on his viewscreen.
Khartoum performs a ritual in an ancient temple.
He prepares a victim for the god Klameth.
The robot brain demands a time-travel mission.
Captain Science and Rip prepare for the journey.
They arrive in the Gobi Desert, 10,000 B.C.
The temple of Klameth looms before them.
They learn of the impending sacrificial ceremony.
They must infiltrate the priesthood to survive.
Captain Science spots two unsuspecting priests.
He and Rip launch a daring ambush.
They quickly tie up their victims.
They join the procession into the temple.
Gongs and trumpets signal the ritual's start.
